title: File:Talatol ghar terrace.jpg
author: Supratim Deka Nupu
description: Talatol Ghar, a 7 storied palace built by the Ahom king Rajeswar Singha. Located outside the town of Sibsagar, Assam, India. This palace has 3 underground floors and has 2 secret tunnels from the lowermost  floor which connected it to the palace in Gargaon and to the Dikhow river.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
classification_note: Classified from source title/category; not a full visual authentication.
